verdict.rationale: SSH access to a GPU instance is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents kubeconfig and kubectl access to managed CKS clusters running on bare-metal nodes. Nothing documents SSH login with user-supplied keys or root-level control of a node, and kubectl cluster access is an adjacent feature, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment
